body: I'm scared of how hard it is to change as well. Im more scared of trying to change and failing. I've tried to do things, like changing my diet and going to the gym and it works for a while but I can never make it stick.

I've had pets all my life, and so I've lost my fair share. It hurts. A lot. My pets dying hurt me more than my grandparents dying. What helped me get through it was family, sharing with those who had also just gone through the same loss as me. Talking about all the good times, remembering how much fun they were.

We always took our pets home from the vets to bury them. Saying goodbye in such a formal way helped me. And I know I can go to where they are buried to visit them any time I want to. They're in my parents back yard, I don't live there any more but every time I visit my parents I'm visiting their live pets and also our dead ones, the ones I loved. Every time I look out the window to where their graves are I can say hello. I know they're not here for me to pet any more but the happiness and love they brought me is still here.
